tasks.prompt:
We need to complete a real development change in this pinned project. First inspect the actual source and supplied business reproduction, explain the relevant call path and edge cases, and raise any clarification questions. Propose a concrete plan with compatibility and test coverage, and wait for my confirmation before editing. Continue the implementation and any validation fixes in this same conversation and workspace. The following describes the eventual delivery scope, not an instruction to skip investigation or plan agreement:

Fix Scheduler.run_all so delay_seconds is applied only between jobs in the current snapshot, with no trailing delay. Preserve execution order, snapshot semantics, callback arguments, cancellation and exception propagation. Add focused public regression tests. Do not change unrelated scheduling behavior. Use the pinned checkout as evidence and cite the relevant source symbols. State assumptions and missing information. Preserve existing public behavior unless this task explicitly requests a change.
